brief:
The Palestinian National Defense Authority has begun preparing legal files in cooperation with international lawyers and human rights experts to challenge frozen bank accounts in Gaza, Shehab Wire reported. The initiative marks an attempt to address what officials characterize as a banking crisis affecting residents of the territory.

The authority intends to file lawsuits against the administration of Bank Fal as part of the broader effort. Officials have enlisted international legal counsel to bolster their case, signaling an escalation in efforts to resolve account freezes that have disrupted financial services across the Gaza Strip.
